title: Revit Family Content Governed Fields

entries.name: Family identity
entries.requirement: Each governed loadable family shall have a stable family identity aligned with the applicable S4 family naming standard.

entries.name: Content class
entries.requirement: Each family shall identify whether it is governed reusable library content, project-specific loadable content, in-place content, or temporary content.

entries.name: Reuse expectation
entries.requirement: Repeatable components, standard equipment, vendor items, and content intended for reuse shall use governed loadable-family content unless an approved exception applies.

entries.name: Schedule and tag expectation
entries.requirement: Content intended to be scheduled, tagged, or tracked shall use a governed content form and governed parameter carriers appropriate to that use.

entries.name: Parameter dependencies
entries.requirement: Governed family content shall reference the applicable S8 parameter identities needed for information requirements, tags, schedules, classification, or downstream exchange.

entries.name: Material dependencies
entries.requirement: Where family appearance or material identity is governed, the family shall use approved material definitions rather than uncontrolled project-local substitutes.

entries.name: Library source
entries.requirement: Governed reusable content shall be traceable to its approved library, template, or other controlled source.

entries.name: Type and variation basis
entries.requirement: Dynamic sizes, ratings, states, and other governed variation shall be carried by types or parameters where appropriate rather than proliferating duplicate family identities.

entries.name: Change control
entries.requirement: Changes to governed reusable families, including rename, repurpose, replacement, or deprecation, shall follow the applicable standards/library change process.

non_promoted_source_content: No exhaustive family library catalogue, discipline-specific family list, geometry recipe, or type catalogue is invented where the source does not provide an approved governed dataset.
No visual richness or geometric complexity is treated as evidence of permitted use or information maturity.
